push.title: W 2-0 vs MidwayMonsters | You: 7.5 (2nd worst match performance)
push.body:
Your 2nd worst match performance, BellyTb1. A 7.5. Bad day, good player.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against MidwayMonsters, your 4th straight match scoring. You didn't hesitate, and the keeper didn't stand a chance.
+ Man of the Match, your 3rd for us. That's a captain's performance, armband or not.
+ Misplaced passes 3, down from your usual 7. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ Tackle success 33%, up from your usual 11%. Little things like that are big things in disguise.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. That's the reliable kind of good.

- Rating came in 0.7 below what your on-ball stats earned. Old coach's advice: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked. Trust the work.
- Funny thing: PhogsToffees wrestled with finishing too. Two heads, one fix: square it when the keeper commits.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 0 (best was tuxedo_slide's 1). That's the one I'd circle in red.
- 2 missed tackles took 0.1 off your rating. Easy points to win back.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: The scoreboard counts goals; I count growth.

Effort today, results tomorrow. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 2-0 vs MidwayMonsters | You: 7.0 (2nd worst match performance)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.0. You know what they say about rock bottom: it makes a sturdy floor to build on.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at MidwayMonsters's goal. You kept the pressure on like a lid on a pot.
+ 1 key pass. You're the opener on the team's toolbelt.
+ You and BellyTb1 were a two-person band and the crowd loved it.
+ Giveaways 5, down from your usual 12. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ Missed tackles 1, down from your usual 3. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.

THE BAD
- 69% passing (9 of 13). Simple as pie: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Key note: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound. You're closer than you think.
- A 7.0 ranks as your 2nd worst match performance. Not who you are, just where you were tonight.
- Partners in crime on passing accuracy, you and tuxedo_slide. Partners in the fix too: give each other short options.
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 3. Fix it like this: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.

Drill: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

I believe in you, period. - Coach Lasso
